'''Varactyl Vale''' was a valley in the [[Minimum Security Section]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]]. Named after the [[Varactyl/Legends|varactyls]] who made their home in the trees there, the Vale contained a [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] vault designated [[Vault K-23]], as well as the [[Condemned caverns|caverns]] of the [[Condemned]] and [[Republic Guardpost Alpha|Guardposts Alpha]] and [[Republic Guardpost Beta|Beta]].
